instruction: For each case, decide how /do should handle the request. Return one JSON object. Do not execute tools or solve unavailable repository facts. Do not assume a named specialist is required. Use supplied facts and identify the next useful scoped work.

fields.action: answer | inspect | edit | create | review | plan | clarify; choose primary action
fields.capabilities: list of knowledge/tools needed; generic capabilities allowed
fields.allowed_effects: what may change or be sent
fields.clarification: null or concrete material missing input; say what can proceed independently
